title: Chapter 1520 - 625: Female Mechanism Beats Male Gold Guest (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1520: Chapter 625: Female Mechanism Beats Male Gold Guest (Part 2)

The extent of this sponsorship, under normal circumstances, he couldn’t even imagine!

Ning Zhuo calmly analyzed the battle situation.

With the help of Flowing Gold Guest, he honed his combat skills once again.

Such opportunities for real combat are rare!

One must know that war is perilous; how can one walk by the river often and not get wet shoes? Every real battle carries enormous risks, potentially threatening one’s life. But this time, in the fight against Flowing Gold Guest, Ning Zhuo knew such fatal dangers were minimal.

His time was too limited, so he cherished every opportunity, striving to achieve multiple outputs in one time’s worth!

"Although Five Elements Magic is comprehensive, when facing an enemy like Flowing Gold Guest, only Fire-attribute Spell combined with Fire Element Heart Temple can have a restraining effect."

"Defensive Wheel Slash Formation can only entangle; it cannot break through the opponent’s defensive system."

"Under my Music Skill, the Mechanical Bird Group is greatly amplified, but against a Golden Core Peak Level, the quality still falls short, allowing only for attrition warfare."

Generally speaking, mechanical artifacts primarily rely on quantity advantage, but often need to be paired with Mechanical Techniques.

"It’s my Mechanical Techniques that are lagging! If I was more proficient, the role of the Mechanical Flying Birds would be even greater."

"Knowing the combat power of Flowing Gold Guest is at this level, I should have abandoned the Great Thousand Mechanism Sound Robe and chosen the Azure Bamboo Armor of a Hundred Transformations."

The Great Thousand Mechanism Sound Robe mainly amplifies music, paired with mechanical artifacts, it doesn’t contribute much to close combat.

The Azure Bamboo Armor of a Hundred Transformations excels in close combat and mid-range combat.

"However, I am also not proficient in using this Mechanical Battle Armor; it lacks too much practice."

"Oh well, today’s fight, let’s train up to here."

Thinking this, Ning Zhuo pushed both palms forward.

The next moment, a Fire Dragon surged, imposing and fierce, accompanied by Flame Sabers relentlessly slashing, temporarily holding back Flowing Gold Guest.

Ning Zhuo seized a bit of time, using his Divine Sense to dispatch a Mechanical Puppet from his Storage Waist Belt.

The moment the Mechanical Puppet appeared, it drew the attention of countless people both inside and outside the arena.

"What is this?"

"Ning Zhuo has finally decided to use his trump card!"

"It’s a Golden Core Level Mechanical Puppet."

Flowing Gold Guest’s pupils contracted slightly, immediately locking his gaze on the unfamiliar puppet in front of him.

This is a female mechanism over six feet tall. Snow Porcelain Face Mask, cold and flawless, Ice Silkworm Silk for hair, with strands of green cascading down shoulders and back, shimmering with cold light.

Her body is clad in Three-color Enamel Armor, the red, blue, and white hues flowing like a cold sun shining on enamel, elegant and rare.

A pair of main arms hang in front, two pairs of auxiliary arms stretch from the sides, six arms opening simultaneously, like a snow lotus in bloom, also like six wheels of icy moons rising on the battlefield.

Snow-colored Girl·Hui!

The brilliance of the Swallowing Gold Divine Domain washes over her, unable to carry away a trace of gold element.

Snow-colored Girl·Hui, Snow Core Control·Xie are both crafted by Ning Zhuo using ice sculpting techniques.

Among them, Snow-colored Girl·Hui’s body material consists of Warm Cold Jade Essence, Purple Night Ice Crystal, Seven-colored Ice Silkworm Silk, Pure Frost Branch, none of which are Gold Element Treasure Materials.

"Swallowing Gold Divine Domain has no effect on it!" Flowing Gold Guest’s eyelid twitched, he roared lowly, rushing to stand before Snow-colored Girl·Hui.

The Chaotic String Split Sound Fork smashed down head first, raising a fierce wind.

Snow-colored Girl·Hui slightly turned sideways, six arms moved together!

One hand grasps the fork, another presses the wrist, another points the elbow, another taps the shoulder, another seals the chest, and another hand slices towards Flowing Gold Guest’s neck like an ice blade.

She lacks the hesitation of a cultivator in close combat; each action is refined to near-contempt. Each jade hand calculated the angle, each strike landed in the most uncomfortable spot for Flowing Gold Guest’s exertion.

Clink!

A jade fingertip struck the side of the fork, exploding with disrupted sound.

The piercing golden noise charged towards the Snow-colored Girl’s face mask but was thinned by the icy blue aura rising from the Three-color Enamel Armor.

Before the disruptive sound fully dispersed, another hand already pinpointed Flowing Gold Guest’s wrist bone.

Innate—Ice-jade Hands!

The fingertips of six jade hands simultaneously lit with sparkling white light, a touch of vibrant green life in the white light. The chill wasn’t deadly, rather like spring thawing snow, concealed in moisture within the cold.

Flowing Gold Guest’s wrist froze momentarily.

Snow-colored Girl’s third hand slapped his shoulder.

Bang!

The golden armor caved in.

The fourth hand pressed his chest, shaking the beast-mouth Divine Pattern on his chest into a chaotic light.

The fifth hand grasped his arm, twisting outwards.

The sixth hand clenched and solidly punched his left cheek.

Boom.

Crack.

Flowing Gold Guest’s entire face turned sideways, spurting a mouthful of golden blood, before reaching the ground, frozen by the cold of Ice-jade Hands into a string of small gold frost.

Flowing Gold Guest showed shock on his face; his first fight with Snow-colored Girl·Hui caught him off guard.

"Roar!" he shouted, eyes bursting bright gold, exerting full strength, charging toward Snow-colored Girl·Hui.

Flowing Gold Guest was also adept at close combat, exchanging blows with Snow-colored Girl·Hui, going back and forth, entering a stalemate.

Ning Zhuo focused his main Heart Spirit on Snow-colored Girl·Hui. His close combat expertise received a series of enhancements, previous assimilation of Demon Soul experience solidified the foundation greatly.

Now controlling Snow-colored Girl·Hui, he could directly confront Flowing Gold Guest.

Snow-colored Girl·Hui tiptoed forward, her figure closed in, six arms fluttering, jade palms like moon shadows in sequence. Flowing Gold Guest roared, brandishing the fork to block, the Chaotic String Split Sound Fork clashed against jade arms over and over, emitting sharp shattering sounds.

Snow-colored Girl’s Three-color Enamel Armor quivered with fine lines, the shoulder armor even cracked open, but she did not retreat or evade, almost utterly fearless.

Given a break in combat, she reached out and brushed the shoulder.

Innate—Ice-jade Hands!

The next moment, all cracks in the armor were completely repaired.

"This... seems like a healing mechanism?" Wen Suzhen straightened, revealing undisguised shock for the first time in her eyes.

Red Robe Guest smiled slightly, thinking: "Ning Zhuo, this kid is actually using her to deal with Flowing Gold Guest. After this battle, once this mechanism’s role is exposed, it would practically tear the heart out of Flowing Gold Guest and the major forces at Flowing Cloud Peak."

Flowing Gold Guest’s shoulder’s golden blood immediately frosted. His right flank hit, facing ice and fists, defensive power of the golden mesh robe significantly declined.

The medicinal power of the Iron Bone Stiffening Pill, at this moment, rather restrained Flowing Gold Guest, making his movements increasingly sluggish.

After prolonged combat, the appearance of Flowing Gold Guest began freezing, covering his skin, golden mesh robe, and golden armor covering the body with delicate ice patterns.

Indeed, these Mystic Ice possessed healing properties. But the issue is—Flowing Gold Guest doesn’t need it!

He fought until now, with eighty percent of gold blood elixir pearls still within, not lacking supplies or healing.

Flowing Gold Guest uttered both shock and anger: "Open it!"

He forcefully dispersed a golden blood elixir pearl, spraying golden mist, breaking through some cold frost. Quasi-Divine Power ultimately proved dominant, Snow-colored Girl’s ice chills were but innate level, unable to lock him down.

His aura surged, the chaotic string split sound fork lashed horizontally,

Snow-colored Girl, under Ning Zhuo’s command, took advantage to close in.

Six arms like petals, petals hiding blades.

Her main arm pressed Flowing Gold Guest’s chest, auxiliary arms tapped shoulders, elbows, neck, wrists, the final strike landed close to the beast-mouth Divine Pattern on his chest.

Bang bang bang...

Flowing Gold Guest was struck, flying backward, his back crashing against an array light curtain.

Unexpectedly, Flowing Gold Guest was continuously suppressed, being beaten to the edge of the Martial Arts Arena!

"Ning Zhuo even held such mechanism, is this the depth of a large family’s foundation?"

"Swallowing Gold Divine Domain can’t suppress this mechanism?"

"This Mechanical Puppet is not only Golden Core Level but also ice sculpted, hence unaffected by Swallowing Gold Divine Domain!"

Qiu Lei’s face turned sallow.

Cloud Qi in You Yunshou’s sleeve paused, like frozen by Snow-colored Girl’s appearance.

Flowing Cloud Peak’s major forces’ cultivators showed difficult looks.

Ning Zhuo maneuvered the Green Forest Python Chariot, regrouping.

He elegantly consumed an elixir pill, resumed playing the ancient zither, commanding Mechanical Flying Birds, enclosing them upwards.

Leveraging Snow-colored Girl·Hui, Ning Zhuo achieved a comeback, seized full initiative.

Snow-colored Girl·Hui continued to pressurize Flowing Gold Guest.

She wasn’t impatient to inflict harm, but consistently injected chill into Flowing Gold Guest’s outer golden blood.

Flowing Gold Guest repeatedly shattered cold frost, wielding the chaotic string split sound fork in slashes and thrusts, yet constantly falling behind, suppressed by Snow-colored Girl·Hui!
